name: notification-banner
title: Notification Banner
description: A small snackbar with a check icon, an optional action and a close button. Slides up, fades out on dismiss and leaves a button to bring it back.

props.name: actionLabel
props.description: Label of the action button. An empty string hides it.

props.name: showTriggerLabel
props.description: Label of the button that brings the banner back after it was dismissed.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called when the action button is pressed.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the banner starts to close.

props.name: onShow
props.description: Called when the banner is brought back.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the slide and fade take.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
